methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Prusa Research is a bootstrapped enterprise in Robotics & Manufacturing founded by Josef Průša. The broader sector comprises one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. However, the peer universe lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—zero entities meet the narrow filtering criteria of matching stage and valuation tier—which limits conventional peer-median methodology application.

Given these constraints, traditional triangulation approaches are not reliable here. A peer-median calculation across the full 10-company Robotics & Manufacturing sector would introduce substantial selection bias and obscure stage-specific dynamics. The single public comparable and dispersed private set do not provide the density required for statistically meaningful cross-sectional benchmarking. The bootstrapped status further distinguishes Prusa from venture-backed peers, whose valuations reflect different capital structures and growth expectations.

This analysis cannot support a quantitative valuation range without additional data—either comparable transaction multiples, revenue or EBITDA figures for Prusa or direct peers, or forward-looking growth and margin assumptions. A credible estimate would require either identifying private financing events within the peer set or employing cost-of-capital and DCF methods grounded in Prusa's specific financials. The key uncertainty remains the absence of transaction-level or financial disclosure data necessary to calibrate valuation multiples in this nascent, concentrated market segment.
